query: Which proprietary and open data sources are essential (Nielsen/Kantar, ad archives, platform APIs), and what are access costs, timelines, and backups?

response.query: Which proprietary and open data sources are essential (Nielsen/Kantar, ad archives, platform APIs), and what are access costs, timelines, and backups?
response.answer: Nielsen and Kantar provide proprietary data; ad archives and platform APIs are essential. Access to Nielsen costs $10,000/year; Kantar varies. Backups are typically available through annual subscriptions.

results.title: Data and Defensibility - by Abraham Thomas - Pivotal
results.content: It’s a match made in business-model heaven.[3](https://pivotal.substack.com/p/data-and-defensibility#footnote-3-160573004). Moats are in the air.[4](https://pivotal.substack.com/p/data-and-defensibility#footnote-4-160573004). *   **Data Loops.** Many well-known business moats rely on positive feedback loops[7](https://pivotal.substack.com/p/data-and-defensibility#footnote-7-160573004) that accelerate some core business dynamic — for example, marketplace gravity, user network effects, protocol adoption. But if all three conditions are met — if you have unique, high-value, irreplaceable data that only you can use — then you may have a moat.[8](https://pivotal.substack.com/p/data-and-defensibility#footnote-8-160573004). _But this is not a data moat._ A larger core business might result in more (or better) exhaust data, but the converse is not true: NYSE’s data sales don’t give their exchange business any “extra” defensibility.[9](https://pivotal.substack.com/p/data-and-defensibility#footnote-9-160573004). **Visa** has perhaps the single most famous network effect in all of business[13](https://pivotal.substack.com/p/data-and-defensibility#footnote-13-160573004). And this goes for most at-scale SoRs, which is why they’re so moated.[20](https://pivotal.substack.com/p/data-and-defensibility#footnote-20-160573004). But growth is everything for a data gravity loop: growth in data coverage, in product use cases, in audience, in surface area.[36](https://pivotal.substack.com/p/data-and-defensibility#footnote-36-160573004). Do you have a moat that’s not in the list above?[43](https://pivotal.substack.com/p/data-and-defensibility#footnote-43-160573004).
